reviews.title: Wow. Sooo good at the right price
reviews.comment:
Wow. So cheap—and sooo good.
The frame is thin, color accuracy is excellent out of the box, brightness is perfect, and contrast is deep and rich. The eye-care features? Fantastic.
I used to have an old 22" IPS LG monitor—it was literally killing my eyes. This one? A total pleasure to work on. My eyes feel rested, not strained. And the color reproduction? Very good.
The product description says it has a glossy screen, but it doesn’t seem very glossy. Besides, since I have a light source behind me (in front of the screen), it’s not an issue at all.
The resolution is ideal for productivity—now I finally understand why people say upgrading your monitor can be better than upgrading your whole computer.
Excellent monitor. Excellent performance. And at this price? Unbeatable.
reviews.author: Klessk

reviews.title: Great display panel!
reviews.comment: This is a simple monitor with a great display panel. I am surprised how good it is for the price. The stand is cheap but works and I'll be mounting it on an arm anyway. It has very good brightness and clarity for text and an anti-glare screen. I also played War Thunder in "movie mode" on it and it was stunning. 27 inch 1440P seems to be a sweet spot for a display. I'm downsizing from a very nice (and expensive) Dell 34 inch curved Ultra-Sharp that I've had for 6-7 years. I'm completely happy with this MSI monitor. I have it setup for development work and gaming and have ordered another to use with my Mac-mini.
reviews.author: Dr Don

reviews.title: Great all around monitor
reviews.comment: I got this monitor to replace a 12 year old, 21" 1080p monitor I was using as a secondary for work. From that perspective, this is a massive upgrade in size, resolution, and color quality. I use it as a display for my steam deck when it is docked and it works well for that, but I have to keep the resolution down because the deck can't handle 2k for most games. Overall I have been very pleased with the monitor's performance. It is fairly easy to switch between sources using the toggle switch on the back. For what I use this monitor for, it has been fantastic.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: Good office monitor for the price, see inside
reviews.comment:
I purchased (3) of these for use in our new office relocation. They have a good screen on them. The refresh rate is good for office work and not tiring to the eyes. They have quite a few lighting and color modes and some workable speakers onboard. It is important to note that these are NOT gaming panels.
Of the three purchased, one of them has a very strange issue. If my cell phone is on a call and I place it below that monitor the screen on the monitor will black out until I move the phone about a half foot or so away. If the phone isn't on a call it won't do it and we have not found it happening with either of the other two screens.
For these applications I used some Dell Optiplex Ultra PC on a VESA mount right on the back of the monitor. It makes for a super compact application that runs cool and quiet while performing all our office tasks as expected.
reviews.author: M Jordan

reviews.title: A gamer's monitor without the high pricetag
reviews.comment: MSI products are just plain good. Nicest monitor I've owned. There is not 1 con about the monitor, picture is super clear (using DisplayPort with a dedicated 8GB GPU). Simply stunning without dropping an insane amount of cash.
